labels.label: lem:globally_hyperbolic_manifolds_manifolds
labels.note: The BTZ half is e0SingManifold_isFutureDistinguishing and e0Manifold_isFutureDistinguishing (GX.BTZ.Manifolds, axiom-clean). The BTZ~ half is BTZTildeData.isFutureDistinguishing_of_natGloballyHyperbolic: natural GH implies FD for d.causality, for EVERY datum, under DEC-106 + DEC-118 (a). That statement is unchanged from WP-46c, where it was audited clean. The condition left open by the round-1 audit and by WP-46c's audit was that the hypothesis have an instance with BTZ points. It is now met with 0 sorry. natGloballyHyperbolic_of_base states: for every GH E0-manifold M, every y₀, every presentation Φ and every chartwise datum d, d.natCausality.GloballyHyperbolic. Here GloballyHyperbolic is lean-causal's IsCausal plus IsCompact of every diamond, in the SpreadEnd (Fox-completion) topology of MaxBranchedCover, i.e. the natural topology of DEC-106. exists_isChartwise shows that such a datum exists, built exactly as BTZTildeData.nonempty builds it: IsChartwise is discharged by the hch clause of btz_manifold_exists_chartwise_tamifying_reg, verbatim. Witness.lean gives a concrete instance, {τ<0} ⊆ 𝔼₀ with DEC-119's bridge structure, with sing ≠ ∅, M GH, d chartwise and naturally GH, and a point of M̃ over sing M. I tried to satisfy the hypotheses and they are satisfiable, so the implication is not vacuous. The restriction to chartwise data is what DEC-118 (c) accepts ('the chartwise construction of M̃ … accepted'). It is reported (SCOPE (d), REPORT question 1), and it touches only the non-vacuity theorem, not the certificate, which holds for every datum.

labels.label: lem:globally_hyperbolic_manifolds_maximal
labels.note: The certificate is BTZTildeData.isFutureDistinguishing_of_base (GX.BTZ.Manifolds, axiom-clean): from IsBTZSingModelled M and (e0ManifoldCausality M hM).GloballyHyperbolic, FD of d.causality for every datum. That is the paper's hypothesis and the ruled (DEC-118 (a)) conclusion, with nothing added. The paper's own route at l.2361 ('M GH ⇒ M̃ GH ⇒ FD') is now also formalized, with 0 sorry, as isFutureDistinguishing_of_base_viaNatGH, for the chartwise datum. It is correctly listed as 'paper_route' rather than as the certificate, because it carries the extra hypothesis hd. The finding on l.2361 (the Lorentzian covering argument does not transfer as is, because the fibres are infinite and D is not naturally continuous at BTZ ends) is accurate. It matches the obstruction analysis in WP-44c and the actual proof.

dispatch_check: DEC-118 (b), 'M GH ⇒ M̃ GH in the natural topology', is delivered as natGloballyHyperbolic_of_base for the chartwise M̃ (DEC-118 (c)), with 0 sorry. The dispatched finite-sheet lemma is replaced by isCompact_of_liftLocalData, which uses the finitely many centres as chain labels and so needs no bound on the number of sheets. This is an equal-or-stronger mechanism, and the final statement is what is graded. The BTZ-sheet limit step is liftLocalData_sing_of_isChartwise, built on exists_liftedChart_of_isChartwise (one descending chart lifted at every point over its domain, with D∘Ψ = g·btzDevM∘Φ on all of V̂), isCompact_btzBox and isClosed_btzDevLe. LiftLocalData is not a trivialising notion. For every compact Q ⊆ W and every component of p⁻¹(W) it requires ultrafilter convergence inside the component and closedness of ≤. The abstract theorem consumes it only together with the separately discharged facts: strong causality and compact base diamonds from M GH, a continuous causal projection, and monotone paths. The conclusion uses lean-causal's own GloballyHyperbolic with no local redefinition, so no intermediate definition can make it vacuous. natCausality is still the WP-46c definition, and its ≤ is the chart-generated transitive closure, not a degenerate relation. Both rows are certified in full, as the dispatch asked.

statement_fidelity: Every statement takes only the paper's or the ruled hypotheses: IsBTZSingModelled M plus GH of e0ManifoldCausality (DEC-33); the standing manifold context (T2, locally path-connected, first countable, connected), which BTZTildeData and MaxBranchedCover need anyway; and, only in the non-vacuity and paper-route decls, d.IsChartwise. DEC-118 (c) accepts that last hypothesis, the docstring and REPORT disclose it, and exists_isChartwise proves it satisfiable for every M, y₀ and Φ. Nothing hides the conclusion: IsChartwise speaks of the T'-neighbourhood filters of descents, not of compactness or GH. The conclusion is lean-causal's GloballyHyperbolic in the SpreadEnd topology, which is the DEC-106 reading. DEC-55's compact-open definition does not arise here. DEC-106/118 are applied correctly: GH is natural, FD is for the chart-generated ≪, and T_BTZ is used only to build the charts. Both certifying decls are axiom-clean and hold for every datum.
